name: Twilio
description: Send SMS and place voice calls.

providedTools.description: Send a WhatsApp message (via a WhatsApp-enabled Twilio sender).

credentialFields.label: Account SID
credentialFields.help: In the Twilio Console under Account Info. It is the public one of the pair, safe to paste.
credentialFields.patternHelp: An Account SID starts with AC and is 34 characters. If yours starts with SK you have copied an API Key SID instead.

credentialFields.label: Auth Token
credentialFields.help: Beside the Account SID in the Console, behind "show". This is the secret half.
credentialFields.patternHelp: An Auth Token is 32 hex characters with no prefix.

credentialFields.label: From number
credentialFields.help: A number on your account with SMS enabled. A number you have not bought will be refused when it sends, not now.
credentialFields.patternHelp: Include the country code and the plus, like +14155551234.
